description: Lists the stations that checked in to the weekly APRS Thursday net on a UTC date, grouped by country, with totals. The counting window is that Thursday 00:00 UTC minus 6 h to the next day 00:00 UTC plus 6 h, one station per callsign-SSID. Defaults to today (UTC). At most 25 callsigns are listed per country; counts are complete.

date.description: UTC date of the net, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: list_aprs_thursday_participants
title: List APRS Thursday participants
